regions.today: A mix of sunny spells and showers today. While it will be a dry morning for most, the showers will become more frequent through the day. Highest temperatures of 14 to 16 degrees, with moderate southwest to west winds.
regions.tonight: Clear spells with just a few showers feeding in from the west. Lowest temperatures of 5 to 8 degrees, with light to moderate southwest to west winds.
regions.tomorrow: Another day of sunshine and showers. Cloudier conditions will develop over the northern half of the province in the evening. Highest temperatures of 14 to 16 degrees, with moderate westerly winds.
